section: Environmental Studies · Ch42 — Force, Motion & Energy
subject: Environmental Studies
stem: When a moving bus suddenly stops, standing passengers tend to fall forward. This is best explained by:

options.option_text: Newton's Third Law of Motion only
The law of conservation of momentum applied to the passenger alone

explanation: Inertia means a body in motion tends to stay in motion; the passenger's body continues moving forward when the bus stops suddenly.

section: Environmental Studies · Ch42 — Force, Motion & Energy
subject: Environmental Studies
stem: A swimmer pushes water backward with their hands and moves forward. This illustrates:

options.option_text: Newton's Third Law — for every action there is an equal and opposite reaction

explanation: The swimmer's backward push on water is met by an equal, opposite forward push on the swimmer.
